settings.ceo_bio:
DADO is more than porcelain stoneware — it is a combination of quality, design and trust. We approach every product with a focus on long-term value.

Our goal is to offer our customers not only beautiful, but also reliable and contemporary solutions. We continue to develop DADO with a strong commitment to quality and responsibility.
settings.ceo_bio_uz:
DADO — bu shunchaki keramogranit emas, bu sifat, dizayn va ishonch uyg‘unligidir. Biz har bir mahsulotga uzoq muddatli qiymat yaratish nuqtayi nazaridan yondashamiz.

Maqsadimiz — mijozlarimizga nafaqat chiroyli, balki ishonchli va zamonaviy yechimlarni taqdim etish. Biz DADO brendini sifat va mas’uliyat bilan rivojlantirishda davom etamiz.
settings.ceo_bio_ru:
DADO — это не просто керамогранит, а сочетание качества, дизайна и доверия. Мы подходим к каждому продукту с пониманием его долгосрочной ценности.

Наша цель — предлагать клиентам не только красивые, но и надёжные современные решения. Мы продолжаем развивать DADO, сохраняя высокие требования к качеству и ответственности.

DADO is more than porcelain stoneware — it is a combination of quality, design and trust. We approach every product with a focus on long-term value.

Our goal is to offer our customers not only beautiful, but also reliable and contemporary solutions. We continue to develop DADO with a strong commitment to quality and responsibility.

brand_pages.name: Seven
brand_pages.subtitle: CERAMICS
brand_pages.hero_subtitle: Deep black, golden veining and large formats: porcelain stoneware for interiors with presence.
brand_pages.about_text:
SEVEN collections draw on rare black marbles: Portoro, Nero Marquina, Noir Laurent. The veining never repeats from tile to tile, so large surfaces keep the feel of natural stone.

Black works together with light: a polished surface reflects the lamps and adds depth, while a matt one looks calm and contemporary. Paired with gold and brass fittings, SEVEN makes a complete premium interior.

brand_pages.name: Torra
brand_pages.subtitle: TILES
brand_pages.hero_subtitle: Bold colours, decorative patterns and relief surfaces: TORRA collections for interiors with character.
brand_pages.about_text:
TORRA is made for tiles that bring an interior to life. Terrazzo chips, stone relief and decorative patterns change with the light and give depth to a space. Every collection is available as porcelain stoneware or ceramic wall tile, in formats from 300×300 to 600×1200.

The brand is built for designers and architects: collections combine easily and offer ready solutions for an accent wall, a floor or a bar area. All collections can be seen in person at the showroom in Tashkent.

brand_pages.name: Italica
brand_pages.subtitle: CERAMICS
brand_pages.hero_subtitle: Concrete, terrazzo and wood textures in calm, precise and durable ceramics.
brand_pages.about_text:
ITALICA collections speak the language of contemporary architecture: straight lines, large planes, a restrained palette. Concrete and terrazzo textures suit lofts, offices and public spaces, while wood-look tiles bring warmth to residential interiors. Each collection comes in complementary wall and floor formats.

We pay particular attention to the practical qualities of the surface: matt and structured finishes resist slipping, clean easily and withstand daily wear. Large format reduces the number of joints and makes a room feel wider. ITALICA is a choice that stays relevant for years.

brand_pages.name: Crown
brand_pages.subtitle: CERAMICS
brand_pages.hero_subtitle: Collections that preserve the beauty of natural stone in porcelain stoneware.
brand_pages.about_text:
CROWN collections draw on the classic motifs of Italian architecture: white and beige marble, warm travertine, soft limestone. Veins and colour transitions are reproduced with the naturalness of real stone, so the interior never feels heavy.

The brand offers a single colour system for floors and walls: within one collection, large-format porcelain stoneware, wall tile and decor elements are coordinated. This helps bring a project to a coherent finish.

brand_pages.name: Gold Mosaic
brand_pages.subtitle: PREMIUM MOSAIC COLLECTION
brand_pages.hero_subtitle: A premium glass mosaic collection designed for hospitality.
brand_pages.about_text:
The GOLD MOSAIC collection is designed for hotel lobbies, restaurants, spas and bathrooms. Each 300×300 mm sheet is assembled from glossy, textured and convex gold elements.

The collection’s strengths: a hotel collection, premium quality, water resistance, luxury design and eco-friendly materials. The mosaic is used on walls, in pools and on accent surfaces.
